reviews.title: Biggest Scam Ever
reviews.text:
We are DONE for that we have to pay a monthly subscription just to use a TV remote from our phone. I only downloaded this because the batteries on my remote died. But I’ll save more money by driving to the store, and buying new batteries. 

Sorry, but I grew up in the 50s. When we saw TV remotes start coming into the market by the 60s, most came packaged with a TV that you payed for when buying the TV. But it was NEVER a monthly subscription.

Sorry for the ranting. I’m going to have my grandson pick up new batteries on his way over here. It’ll still be more cost effective than paying a subscription. Have a wonderful day! 😊

reviews.title: Control your fire tv with your phone
reviews.text: This is one of the better free apps I’ve found for controlling my  Fire TV . It’s extremely simple and quick to setup and you can use it for free for most of the basic stuff; like the same thing you would use your remote control for. However you may have to reconnect it several times because it doesn’t have a good range and it tends to disconnect on its own especially if you’re watching something for a while and haven’t used it in a while but It’s convenient for those times when you accidentally misplaced your remote control or you just realized that your batteries are dead. It’s definitely one of the best app options I’ve found and I have tried a few, but try it out , see if it’s a fit, it can’t hurt and if anyone has found a better option. Please lmk in the comments section. I’d be happy to try your suggestions and picks out too!
